subject: Seat mix + add-ons: one-time onboarding fee waiver & discount carveout request
body:
From: Gwen Lee <gwen.lee@healtech.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:11:03 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal questions (seat mix + onboarding)

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the deck — quick clarifying questions before procurement finalizes: HealTech is planning a 600-seat deployment split across 3 user types (admin, clinician, research). Procurement is pushing back on the $30k one-time onboarding fee and wants a blended seat price that preserves our list rate but gives a one-off billing credit until we hit year-1 commit. They also asked if add-ons (vector-search, private VPC) can be itemized rather than bundled.

Can Redwood do a one-time onboarding fee waiver to get this over the line and then structure a usage-based ramp that keeps ARR intact? Tom from procurement is looped.

Appreciate a quick run-down.

—Gwen


On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 09:47, priya_natarajan@redwood.com wrote:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:47:22 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood proposal questions (seat mix + onboarding) — signoff request

Aditya — forwarding HealTech's ask. TL;DR: they want the one-time onboarding fee waived (30k), blended seat pricing to simplify procurement, and add-ons itemized. They will commit to a 12-month minimum with a staged usage ramp that hits ~60% of forecast by month 4. Our margin sensitivity shows the onboarding fee covers ~18% of first-year incremental cost for Dedicated instances in their region.

Attachments: pricing-proposal-v3.xlsx (proposal with seat mix), onboarding-fee-breakdown.csv

Request: approval for a one-time onboarding fee waiver in exchange for a 12-month minimum and a 6% additional uplift to model for a dedicated resourcing surcharge; permission to offer a 10% blended seat-level introductory credit for months 1–3 (applied as invoice credit). This would be a commercial carveout and needs VP/CFO exception.

Background: HealTech is strategic — potential multi-year expansion across two product lines and a referral to a payer partner. If we decline the waiver they will push to our competitor who has offered a smaller onboarding fee + extended free trial.

Can you advise next steps (I think Marissa + Marcus need to sign off).

Thanks,
Priya
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference


On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 10:12, aditya_rao@redwood.com wrote:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:12:40 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood proposal questions (seat mix + onboarding) — signoff request

Priya — thanks for the note and the analysis. A few quick asks before I escalate to Marissa/Marcus:
- Confirm the proposed 10% blended credit applies to base seat list price only (not to add-ons).
- Confirm billing mechanics: one invoice credit applied in month 2? Or distributed months 1–3 as line-item credits?
- Please attach the committed minimum language you will include (we need explicit month-by-month minimums if we're waiving onboarding).

Also include an explicit fallback policy: if usage by month 4 < 40% of forecast, we reserve the right to revert to standard onboarding fee and pause discounts.

If you can update the proposal with those changes I will route to Marissa and ask for VP/CFO signoff.

- Aditya
Director, Commercial Sales


On Tue, Jun 22, 2027 at 09:03, priya_natarajan@redwood.com wrote:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:03:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood proposal questions (seat mix + onboarding) — signoff request

Aditya — updated per your asks. Summary of changes: 
- 10% introductory credit applied only to base seats, line-item credit distributed evenly across months 1–3.
- Add-ons (vector search, private VPC) are itemized in the proposal; they are not eligible for the introductory credit.
- Committed minimum: 12-month ARR floor of $820k (monthly minimums listed in attached pricing-proposal-v3.xlsx).
- Fallback clause: if month-4 usage < 40% of forecast, onboarding waiver is rescinded and a one-time charge equivalent to 60% of the onboarding fee will be invoiced.

I attached the redlined proposal and a clean MOU for signature (MOU-HealTech-draft.pdf).

Attachments: pricing-proposal-v3.xlsx, MOU-HealTech-draft.pdf

Please advise if you want me to present to the customer once we have executive approval.

Thanks,
Priya


On Thu, Jun 24, 2027 at 15:04, marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:04:01 -0700
Subject: Requesting Marcus (VP/CFO) for formal signoff — HealTech carveout

Marcus — quick summary: HealTech is asking for a $30k onboarding fee waiver in exchange for a 12-month minimum (ARR floor $820k) and a 10% seat credit months 1–3. We added a fallback clause and itemized add-ons. Financial impact (first-year revenue delta) is ~ -7% on modeled ARR vs list (costs covered by a 6% dedicated surcharge we build into the rate card). This is a strategic account with likely 24–36 month expansion potential.

Request: an executive carveout approval from you to waive the onboarding fee and allow the 10% blended seat credit under the terms in the attached MOU. Please reply with one of: APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CONDITION / DECLINE. If approve with condition, please list specific conditions.

Cc'ing Aditya and Priya so they can record the decision and update the HubSpot deal.

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference


On Thu, Jun 24, 2027 at 17:04, marcus_lin@redwood.com wrote:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting Marcus (VP/CFO) for formal signoff — HealTech carveout

APPROVE WITH CONDITION — see below.

Conditions: 
1) Add an explicit 20% clawback on total credits if cumulative usage at month 6 is > 30% below forecast (applies to all credits issued).
2) Add a minimum 6-month early-termination fee equal to 25% of remaining contracted ARR if they exit before 6 months.
3) Finance to retain 5% of first-month invoice for reserves (to be reconciled month 3).

Operational notes: Priya — please ensure the invoice lines are configured so credits can be automatically applied and clawbacks are straightforward to calculate. Aditya — once contract signed, run the allocation through revenue ops and flag for monthly usage audit for the first 6 months.

If we can confirm the billing flow and that Sales Ops can automate clawbacks, I sign off.

—Marcus
VP / CFO, Redwood Inference


-----Original Message-----
From: HealTech Procurement <procurement@healtech.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 18:12:11 -0700
Subject: RE: Redwood proposal questions (seat mix + onboarding)

Priya / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We see the MOU and the line items. Two clarifying asks before we return the signed doc: 
1) Please confirm the fallback/rescission mechanics for the onboarding waiver (we understand the month-4 check).
2) Can the first invoice be net of the 10% credit (i.e., show credit on invoice rather than future rebate)?

We'll get back quickly once the final MOU includes the conditions.

—Tom (on behalf of HealTech procurement)


[Attachment stubs: pricing-proposal-v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), MOU-HealTech-draft.pdf (document), onboarding-fee-breakdown.csv (csv)]
